C0896.title: Reusing One Password Across Sites? Beware of Credential Stuffing Attacks Stealing Your Personal Info
C0896.summary: From May 2020 to November 2021, defendant Zhang purchased citizens' QQ mailbox and 163 mailbox account credentials via QQ groups, then used a Steam account checker to perform credential stuffing and steal Steam game accounts and passwords, which were resold via QQ groups for profit, earning 30,829 yuan across 113 transactions. The court convicted Zhang of the crime of infringing citizen personal information, sentencing him to one year in prison and a 40,000 yuan fine, with illegal proceeds confiscated.
